info.title: vision-api
info.description: Reusable FastAPI backend template for computer-vision hackathons.

get.description:
Return application operational status, metadata, model readiness, database health, and WS connections.

Performs a lightweight `SELECT 1` query to verify database connectivity,
inspects app.state.detector for model readiness, counts active jobs, and counts open WebSockets.
If the database is unreachable or the detector failed to load, the endpoint
reports status 'degraded' without crashing.

Return 200 with {'status': 'ready'} only when database responds to SELECT 1 and detector is loaded.

Otherwise returns HTTP 503 Service Unavailable detailing which dependency failed.

post.description:
Register a new user account.

- Assigned role is strictly enforced as 'user'.
- Rejects duplicate email or username with HTTP 409 Conflict.
- Password is encrypted with Argon2id before database storage.

post.summary: Log in and retrieve JWT access and refresh tokens
post.description:
Authenticate with username/email and password.

- Supports logging in via either username or email in the 'username' form field.
- Uses constant-time dummy hash verification when a user is absent to mitigate timing attacks.
- Returns generic 'Incorrect credentials' for both invalid username and password.
- Rejects inactive user accounts with HTTP 401.

post.summary: Renew access token using a valid refresh token
post.description:
Validate a refresh token and return a fresh token pair.

- Rejects access tokens used on this endpoint with HTTP 401.
- Rejects expired or malformed tokens.

get.description: Return profile information for the currently authenticated user.
Retrieve all registered users. Restricted to users with the 'admin' role.

post.summary: Upload video and submit background detection job
post.description:
Upload a video file and submit an asynchronous detection job.

- Validates MIME type, streaming file size limit (HTTP 413), and container magic bytes.
- Saves video under UUID filename in UPLOAD_DIR/videos/.
- Returns HTTP 503 if detector is not loaded/available.
- Limits active (pending/running) jobs per user to MAX_ACTIVE_JOBS_PER_USER (HTTP 429).
- Submits job to ThreadPoolExecutor (or processes inline if JOB_RUNNER_INLINE is True).
- Cleans up orphan uploaded video file if database insertion fails.
- Returns HTTP 202 Accepted with {job_id, status, progress, created_at}.

post.summary: Upload image and perform object detection
post.description:
Upload an image file, validate dimensions/format, run detection, and save results.

- Validates MIME type, file size (streaming 413 cutoff), and Pillow image decoding.
- Accepts optional multipart form fields: required_equipment and camera_name.
- Saves image to disk under a generated UUID filename in UPLOAD_DIR/images/.
- Returns 503 if detector is not loaded/available.
- Runs inference via run_inference() protecting against queue saturation (503) and timeout (504).
- If detector returns PPE schema ('ppe.v1'), runs validate_detector_output and apply_rules.
- Cleans up orphan uploaded image file if inference or database commit fails.
- Persists detection metadata, counts, and bounding box JSON in the database.

get.description:
Retrieve detection records ordered newest first.

- Standard users only see their own detections.
- Administrators can view all system detection records.

schema.title: Response Get Detection History Detect History Get

get.summary: Retrieve detection pipeline and PPE configuration
get.description:
Retrieve active detector backend status, PPE equipment rules, and upload limits.

Declared before /{detection_id} so the string 'config' is never parsed as a numeric ID.
Requires authentication.

get.summary: Download original image for a detection
get.description:
Retrieve the original uploaded image file associated with a detection record.

- Only accessible to the record owner or administrators (404 otherwise).
- Checks path traversal containment within UPLOAD_DIR.
- Sets Cache-Control: private, max-age=300.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific detection by ID
get.description:
Retrieve a single detection record by its database ID.

- Accessible if the record belongs to the requesting user or if user is an admin.
- Returns 404 if not found or unauthorized to prevent disclosing record existence.

Retrieve processing job status, progress, errors, and inference results.

- Accessible if the job belongs to the requesting user or if user is an admin.
- Returns 404 if not found or unauthorized to prevent disclosing job existence.
- Result payload is populated only when status is 'done'; otherwise null.

get.summary: List background jobs with pagination and status filter
get.description:
Retrieve job records ordered newest first.

- Standard users only see their own jobs.
- Administrators can view all background jobs.
- Supports optional filtering by job status.

get.summary: List alerts with pagination and optional filtering
get.description:
Retrieve alerts ordered newest first.

- Standard users only see their own alerts.
- Administrators can see alerts for all users.
- Supports filtering by level and read status.

Return the total number of unread alerts.

- Standard users receive the count of their own unread alerts.
- Administrators receive the total unread count across all users.

patch.summary: Mark a specific alert as read
patch.description:
Mark an alert as read.

- Accessible by the alert owner or an administrator.
- Attempting to mark another user's alert returns HTTP 404.

post.summary: Mark all caller alerts as read
post.description: Mark all unread alerts belonging to the caller as read.

get.summary: Get aggregated detection and alert analytics summary
get.description:
Retrieve summarized statistics across detections and alerts.

- Standard users see only their own data.
- Administrators see statistics aggregated across all users.
